data.body:
Phase 1 RCA (worktree fix-17c3, HEAD 1ab859777a) — CONFIRMED at runtime.

Mechanism (one root cause, two visible facets): the outbound comment differ produces its two
body-equality keys with DIFFERENT decode compositions.

- Jira side (outbound_comments.py:527): `_normalize_comment_body(fetched_wire)` ->
  `inbound_fields.normalize_rich_text` -> `adf_to_text` — never escapes.
- Local side (outbound_comments.py:571-573): `_normalize_comment_body(
  codec.normalize_outbound(sanitizer.fit_comment(body)))`. Under
  `rich_text_cutover="cloud"`, `AdfCodec(rich=True).normalize_outbound` is
  `adf_to_markdown(markdown_to_adf(text))` — a markdown round trip that ESCAPES
  markdown-active characters and rewrites autolinks (`[link](http://x)` ->
  `[link](<http://x>)`).

Discriminating runtime experiment: captured the REAL wire from `acli_cli_ops.add_comment`
(only `acli_subprocess._run_acli` stubbed) with the in-limit markdown body from this ticket.
Result: local key carries the escapes, landed key does not, `_diff_comments` re-emits the
already-landed body (1 duplicate mutation). Exactly reproduces the recorded repro.

Deeper send-path fact the experiment surfaced (same root cause, explains why the rich round
trip can NEVER match): the send path encodes the DECORATED body
(`to_wire(fit_preserving_marker(decorate(body), fit_outbound))`, acli_cli_ops.py:531), and the
decoration `<!-- rebar:reconciler-echo -->` is an HTML comment, so `markdown_to_adf`'s
documented content-preservation fallback (adf.py:421-446) degrades the WHOLE document to the
plain `text_to_adf` encode — the landed wire is the literal markdown source in plain
paragraphs, while the local key is the rich round trip of the UNDECORATED body.

Fix (matches the recorded direction "produce both keys with one decoder"): derive the local
key by predicting the wire as-sent and decoding it with the SAME decoder as the Jira side:
`_normalize_comment_body(codec.to_wire(_decorate_outbound_comment(sanitizer.fit_comment(body))))`.
`decorate(fit_comment(body)) == fit_preserving_marker(decorate(body), fit)` in every
non-pathological case because `fit_comment` (= `fit_comment_as_sent`) is that composition with
the decoration taken back off. Verified in an 8-cell matrix (cutover off/cloud x in-limit md /
over-length md / plain in-limit / oversize plain): new key == landed key in ALL cells; old key
diverged in 3 cloud cells; every cell where the old key matched still matches (no loosening,
no shifted in-limit plain key). Send-path behavior untouched.

Plan-review advisory (G6) noted: the pathological `fit_comment_as_sent` branch (bare
decoration itself does not fit) would make re-decoration diverge from the wire — unreachable
for real comments (the ~30-char decoration against a 32,000-char serialized budget); dedup in
that cell is best-effort either way.

Defect attribution (caused_by): commit 27b868ba55 "Append-only comment sync with comment-ID
map", ticket 789c-1251-fc21-4cf6 (emersed-specific-mutt). That change simultaneously (a) moved
the send path onto codec ADF encoding of the decorated body and (b) flipped `_resolve_codec`'s
default so the LOCAL key routes through the flag-governed `normalize_outbound` — while leaving
the Jira-side decode on `normalize_rich_text`/`adf_to_text`. The asymmetry is born there:
before it, the local key never passed through a markdown round trip. `git log -S` over both
key sites names it directly; a32a (3f5880cea9) only introduced the identity-default codec seam
and created no divergence. Not attributable to e339-9709 (which fixed the FIT divergence and
filed this ticket as its residual).
